answer: Anyone running 44 aliases thus needs 89 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in opal, expire in timber, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2493 identities would post 2060 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
